title: Soft Vol
append: Add one object to series.json points after the official cash close. Keep dates ascending, one point per session, from 2026-10-30. npm run soft-vol:close writes the point and rewrites latest.json.

routine.cadence: Weekdays after the official cash close. Equity cash close is 4:00 PM ET (3:00 PM CT). The VIX close prints later the same afternoon, about 4:15 PM ET (3:15 PM CT). A pass around 3:30 CT is only final once those official closes are out. If the script ran before they were out, rerun the same session with --replace-last and re-commit. Do not append a second point for that session.
routine.command: npm run soft-vol:close -- --date 2026-11-03 --vix 19.00 --spx <21 SPX closes, oldest first, last is the session>
writes: series.json: one close appended, origin close-routine
latest.json: the same close, closed true, seriesBreak 2026-11-02
rules: Never rewrite or delete an earlier session. --replace-last rewrites only the last session, and only when --date is that session.
Pass the official VIX close and 21 official SPX closes. The script computes HV20. It does not fetch.
Soft Vol does not take an underlying-vol change. Leave Vol Stress on its own close routine.
Chart scale stays −5 to +15. Buckets stay at ±0.4.
The example object is a shape, not a filed session.
